## A Mathematics Website {.project-entry}

This website is an ongoing project. I check the mathematics in my study notes and work on explaining it more clearly. I revise the pages as I learn more. The site uses Quarto and is hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Multiclass SVM {.project-entry}

This project explains how the Crammer-Singer method trains one model for several classes. The strongest rival sets the margin for each example. The project connects this idea to hinge loss, the primal and dual problems, and kernels.

[Read the Crammer-Singer project](projects/multiclass-svm-crammer-singer.qmd)
